description: Spindle bearing seizure or loss of spindle accuracy. Replacement parts are required and the failure carries a safety implication.
Thermal overload of the spindle or drive assembly. Carries a safety implication and is corrected without spare parts.
Progressive bearing wear observed as rising vibration. A replacement bearing is required.
Fault in the drive motor or its servo module. A replacement electrical part is required.
Loss of lubricant delivery or pressure in the lubrication circuit. A replacement part is required.
Controller, communication or program fault in the automation system. Corrected without spare parts.
Cutting tool worn beyond its usable limit or broken during a cut. Replacement tooling is required.
Wear, slippage or breakage of a drive belt or chain. A replacement part is required.
Shaft misalignment or rotating imbalance. Corrected by adjustment without spare parts.
Sensor drift, disconnection or instrumentation failure. A replacement sensor is required.
Loss of compressed air pressure in the pneumatic circuit. Corrected without spare parts.
Material jam or blockage obstructing the process. Carries a safety implication and is cleared without spare parts.
